name: Color-Preserving Occupancy Voxelization
definition: Computes an occupancy grid where voxel values store the index of the first face that intersects the voxel, preserving color information by mapping face indices to voxel values.
summary: Color-Preserving Occupancy Voxelization stores the first intersecting mesh face index in each voxel to retain color data, differing from standard binary occupancy grids by mapping face indices to voxel values.
